reviews.title: Unhelpful
reviews.text: You will not develop in your mental capabilities with this app. The tasks are far too simple, and the tests (which you must pay to see the results of) are also far easier than they should be and likely give inaccurate results. For example, the IQ tests was possibly the most basic IQ test I have ever seen and I don’t imagine it would be difficult to score in the top bracket. Unhelpful and not worth your time.

reviews.title: Getting worse
reviews.text:
I don’t know what is going on with this application’s developers. they take a reasonable application and change it so much you cannot do simple tasks anymore. for example, why on earth would anyone change the daily quizzes into multiple tasks that don’t even recognize when you complete six games, much less the three required to complete daily tasks? 

i’ve repeatedly had a problem with it not recognizing my purchases, and that was quite annoying. btw, they never replied to my emails re those issues. i even let them get away with that. 

i’m done now. — it’s no longer the app i started using. not having support is disappointing however, they really lost the thread of what made this game enjoyable — especially for those with limited time for games.
